items.title: Sex-dependent effects of psychedelics: review of evidence from rodent models.

summaries.en: This rodent model review examines sex-dependent effects of psychedelics (psilocybin, LSD, DMT, mescaline, and related compounds) acting via 5-HT2A receptor agonism. Evidence reveals notable sex differences in pharmacodynamics, serotonergic and dopaminergic signaling, amygdala reactivity, and dendritic spine formation. Behavioral outcomes—head twitch responses, locomotor activity, prepulse inhibition, stress reactivity, and social behavior—frequently show stronger or distinct effects in females, with ovarian cycle phase further modulating responses. Disease models demonstrate sex-dependent therapeutic outcomes for alcohol consumption and affective behavior. The review concludes sex is a critical biological variable in psychedelic neurobiology and behavioral effects.
summaries.da: Dette rodent-modelreview undersøger kønsafhængige effekter af psykedelika (psilocybin, LSD, DMT, meskalin og relaterede stoffer) som virker via 5-HT2A-receptoragonisme. Evidensen viser betydelige kønsforskelle i farmakodynamik, serotonergt og dopaminergt signalering, amygdalarespons og dendrittiske ryg-dannelse. Adfærdsmæssige resultater—head twitch-respons, motorisk aktivitet, prepulse-inhibition, stressreaktivitet og social adfærd—viser ofte stærkere eller forskellige effekter hos hunner, hvor ovariefasecyklus yderligere modulerer responserne. Sygdomsmodeller demonstrerer kønsafhængige terapeutiske udfald for alkoholforbrug og affektiv adfærd. Reviewet konkluderer, at køn er en kritisk biologisk variabel i psykedelikas neurobiologi og adfærdsmæssige effekter.

items.title: Treatment-resistant Depression in the Post-ketamine Era: Unmet Needs beyond Rapid Response.

summaries.en: Ketamine and esketamine have revolutionized treatment-resistant depression (TRD) by inducing rapid antidepressant effects within hours. However, critical questions remain: durability of initial benefits, relapse prevention, maintenance and tapering strategies, functional recovery outcomes, patient selection criteria, predictive biomarkers, and long-term safety of repeated glutamatergic treatment. This review argues that research priorities should shift from acute efficacy to durability, functional recovery, and implementation value.
summaries.da: Ketamin og esketamin har transformeret behandlingen af depressiv lidelse, der modstår medicinsk behandling (TRD) ved at inducere hurtig antidepressiv effekt inden for timer. Kritiske spørgsmål forbliver ubesvarede: varighed af initial effekt, tilbagefaldsprophylakse, vedligeholdelses- og nedtrapningsstrategier, funktionel bedring, patientudvælgelse, prædiktive biomarkører og langtidssikkerhed ved gentaget glutamatergi. Reviewet argumenterer for, at forskningsprioriteter bør skiftes fra akut effektivitet til varighed, funktionel bedring og implementeringsværdi.

items.title: Politically Salient Events May Modulate Effects of Naturalistic Psychedelic Use on Support for Partisan Violence.

summaries.en: A longitudinal observational study (n=12,345 at follow-up) examined how timing of naturalistic psychedelic use relates to support for partisan violence. Among 505 participants reporting psychedelic use over two months, those whose most intense experience occurred on July 4th (n=19) showed decreased support for partisan violence. Similar associations appeared for experiences timed with the Trump assassination attempt. Conversely, psychedelic experiences near party conventions or Election Day were associated with increased support for partisan violence. Results suggest sociocultural context modulates psychedelics' effects on political attitudes.
summaries.da: Et længdeforløbsstudie (n=12.345 ved opfølgning) undersøgte sammenhængen mellem timing af naturalistisk psykedelika-brug og støtte til partidan vold. Blandt 505 deltagere, der rapporterede psykedelika-brug over to måneder, viste de med mest intens oplevelse på juli 4. (n=19) reduceret støtte til partisan vold. Lignende sammenhænge fandtes for oplevelser tidssat med mordattentat på Trump. Omvendt var psykedelika-oplevelser nær partikongresser eller valgdagen forbundet med øget støtte til partisan vold. Resultaterne tyder på, at sociokulturel kontekst modulerer psykedelikas effekter på politiske holdninger.

items.title: Convergent neuroimmune signaling underlying rapid antidepressant response to ketamine and psychedelics.

summaries.en: Researchers integrated CSF proteomics, iPSC transcriptomics, MEG, and plasma cytokine analyses to identify shared mechanisms underlying rapid antidepressant response to ketamine and psychedelics. Across multiple modalities (n=16-39 TRD participants, n=11-25 healthy controls), immune signaling molecules IL-15 and MCP-1 emerged as key regulatory hubs. Ketamine responders showed decreased IL-15 and elevated B-cell signaling at baseline, reversed post-treatment. Plasma IL-7 correlated with MEG gamma power across participants, suggesting neuroimmune convergence despite distinct receptor mechanisms.
summaries.da: Forskere integrerede CSF-proteomik, iPSC-transkriptomik, MEG og plasmaprøver for at identificere fælles mekanismer bag hurtig antidepressiv effekt af ketamin og psykedelika. På tværs af flere målemetoder (n=16-39 behandlingsresistente depression-patienter, n=11-25 kontroller) fremstod IL-15 og MCP-1 som vigtige regulatoriske knudepunkter. Ketaminrespondere viste lavere IL-15 og forhøjet B-celle-signalering ved baseline, som blev reverseret efter behandling. Plasma IL-7 korrelerede med MEG-gammaaktivitet, hvilket tyder på neuroimmun konvergens på trods af forskellige receptormekanismer.

items.title: Feasibility, safety and preliminary effects of ibogaine in patients with moderate and severe alcohol use disorder: a pilot, open-label study.

summaries.en: This open-label pilot study examined ibogaine's feasibility and safety in nine patients with moderate to severe alcohol use disorder. Participants received escalating oral doses (20–400 mg) with 24–48 hour hospitalization and continuous monitoring. Primary outcomes assessed cardiovascular effects, vital signs, and adverse effects. QTc interval alterations occurred in five patients, and mild-to-moderate effects (drowsiness, nausea, anxiety) were common at higher doses. Two patients required medication for agitation and hypertension. Most reported reduced alcohol use, though only five completed the study. Results indicate ibogaine's cardiotoxic potential requires rigorous cardiovascular screening.
summaries.da: Dette åbent pilot-studie undersøgte ibogains mulighed og sikkerhed hos ni patienter med moderat til svær alkoholbrug. Deltagere modtog eskalerende orale doser (20–400 mg) med 24–48 timers hospitalisering og kontinuerlig overvågning. Primære udfald vurderede kardiovaskulære effekter, vitale tegn og bivirkninger. QTc-interval-ændringer forekom hos fem patienter, og milde-til-moderate effekter (døsighed, kvalme, angst) var hyppige ved højere doser. To patienter krævede medicin for agitation og hypertension. De fleste rapporterede reduceret alkoholforbrug, selvom kun fem gennemførte studiet. Resultaterne indikerer ibogains kardiotoxiske potentiale kræver stringent kardiovaskulær screening.

items.title: Candidate Biomarkers of Bipolar Disorder Progression: Implications for Ketamine and Psychedelic Interventions.

summaries.en: A narrative review examined biomarkers of bipolar disorder progression and their relevance to ketamine and psychedelic interventions. Synthesizing evidence from PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science searches (December 2025–February 2026), researchers identified associations between advanced bipolar disorder and abnormalities in inflammatory signaling, neurotrophic regulation, neuroimaging, and epigenetic processes. However, findings were heterogeneous with modest effect sizes, predominantly cross-sectional designs, and candidate biomarkers often reflecting current mood state rather than cumulative illness progression. Peripheral BDNF and inflammatory markers showed limited specificity for disease progression.
summaries.da: Et narrativt review undersøgte biomarkører for progressionen af bipolær lidelse og deres relevans for ketamin- og psykedelika-interventioner. Gennem søgninger i PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus og Web of Science (december 2025–februar 2026) identificerede forskerne sammenhænge mellem fremskreden bipolær lidelse og abnormiteter i inflammatorisk signalering, neutrofisk regulering, neuroimaging og epigenetiske processer. Resultaterne var imidlertid heterogene med beskedne effektstørrelser, overvejende tværsnitsdesign, og kandidatbiomarkører afspejlede ofte nuværende humørtilstand snarere end kumulativ sygdomsprogresssion. Periferisk BDNF og inflammatoriske markører viste begrænset specificitet for sygdomsprogresssion.

items.title: Dimensional effect profiles in treatment-resistant depression: A naturalistic, prospective head-to-head comparison of arTMS, esketamine nasal spray, and oral brexpiprazole.

summaries.en: A prospective, naturalistic study compared three treatments for treatment-resistant depression (n=101): esketamine nasal spray, accelerated repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation, and brexpiprazole augmentation. After one month, all treatments significantly reduced depressive severity and anhedonia. Brexpiprazole showed greater improvement in rumination, while esketamine enhanced affective and cognitive symptoms. Both esketamine and arTMS demonstrated anxiolytic effects, suggesting distinct dimensional profiles across treatments in routine clinical practice.
summaries.da: En prospektiv, naturalistisk undersøgelse sammenlignede tre behandlinger for behandlingsresistent depression (n=101): esketamin næsespray, accelereret repetitiv transkraniel magnetstimulation og brexpiprazol-augmentering. Efter en måned reducerede alle behandlinger signifikant depressionsalvorsgrad og anhedoni. Brexpiprazol viste større forbedring i rumination, mens psykedelika forbedrede affektive og kognitive symptomer. Både psykedelika og arTMS demonstrerede anxiolytiske effekter med tilsyneladende adskilte dimensionelle profiler.

items.title: Adjunctive Pharmacotherapy for Major Depressive Disorder with Anxiety Symptoms: from Monoamines to Recent Clinical Evidence.

summaries.en: This review examines adjunctive pharmacotherapy for major depressive disorder (MDD) with comorbid anxiety symptoms, which indicate greater severity and poorer outcomes. Focusing on monoamine dysregulation (noradrenaline, serotonin, dopamine), the authors survey clinical evidence for first- and second-line treatments including atypical antipsychotics, bupropion, ketamine/esketamine, lithium, and others. Current guidelines lack specific recommendations for this patient population despite their significant treatment burden.
summaries.da: Denne oversigt undersøger adjuvant farmakologi til depressiv sygdom med samtidig angst, som indikerer større alvor og dårligere udfald. Med fokus på monoamin-dysregulering (noradrenalin, serotonin, dopamin) gennemgår forfatterne kliniske resultater for først- og andenlinjebehandlinger, herunder atypiske antipsykotika, bupropion, ketamin/esketamin og litium. Nuværende retningslinjer mangler specifikke anbefalinger for denne patientgruppe trods deres betydeligt behandlingsbehov.

items.title: Hepatic Safety of Ketamine and Esketamine for Treatment-Resistant Depression: A Real-World Cohort Study.

summaries.en: A historical cohort study of 51 patients with treatment-resistant depression receiving IV ketamine or intranasal esketamine at Mayo Clinic (2017-2024) found no clinically meaningful changes in liver enzyme trajectories. Three patients (5.9%) showed elevations ≥2× upper limit of normal, all attributable to alcohol, myalgia, or pre-existing steatosis rather than ketamine or esketamine exposure. Results suggest subanesthetic ketamine and FDA-approved esketamine doses do not pose hepatic safety concerns during therapeutic use.
summaries.da: Et historisk kohortestudie af 51 patienter med behandlingsresistent depression, der modtog IV ketamin eller intranasal esketamin på Mayo Clinic (2017-2024), viste ingen klinisk betydningsfulde ændringer i leverenzymer. Tre patienter (5,9%) havde forhøjelser ≥2× normal øvre grænse, alle tilskrevet alkohol, myalgi eller eksisterende steatose snarere end ketamin eller esketamin. Resultaterne tyder på, at subanæstetiske doser psykedelika ikke udgør hepatisk sikkerhedsrisiko ved terapeutisk brug.

items.title: CB1R-dependent mitochondrial biogenesis may contribute to the antidepressant effects of esketamine in a chronic variable stress male mouse model.

summaries.en: A mouse study examining esketamine's antidepressant mechanisms found that CB1 cannabinoid receptor signaling in the hippocampus promotes mitochondrial biogenesis—the creation of new mitochondria. Chronically stressed mice treated with a single esketamine dose showed normalized mitochondrial markers (NRF1, TFAM, cytochrome c) and reversed depressive-like behaviors. Blocking CB1 receptors with antagonists prevented both effects, indicating CB1R signaling is essential for esketamine's rapid antidepressant action.
summaries.da: Et musestudium undersøgte esketamins antidepressive mekanismer og fandt, at CB1-cannabinoidreceptorsignalering i hippocampus fremmer mitokondriebiogerese—dannelsen af nye mitokondrier. Kronisk stressede mus behandlet med en enkelt esketamindosis viste normaliserede mitokondriemarører (NRF1, TFAM, cytokrom c) og reverserede depressionslignende adfærd. Blokering af CB1-receptorer med antagonister forhindrede begge effekter, hvilket indikerer, at CB1R-signalering er væsentlig for esketamins hurtige antidepressive virkning.

items.title: Systems-based psychiatry: insights from psychedelic research on mechanisms of healing.

summaries.en: This theoretical paper proposes a systems-based framework for psychiatry, arguing that mental disorders reflect stable patterns within dynamic multilevel systems rather than isolated biological dysfunction. Drawing on neuroscience, complexity science, and psychedelic research, the authors conceptualize therapeutic change as a three-phase process: perturbation, reorganization, and consolidation. Psychedelics exemplify this mechanism by transiently destabilizing entrenched patterns, increasing flexibility for reorganization. Recovery is reframed as enhanced coherence and adaptive capacity across domains, not merely symptom reduction. This model generalizes across therapeutic modalities and has implications for clinical practice and research design.
summaries.da: Dette teoretiske paper foreslår en systembaseret ramme for psykiatri, idet forfatterne argumenterer, at psykiske lidelser afspejler stabile mønstre inden for dynamiske flerniveausystemer snarere end isoleret biologisk dysfunktion. Med udgangspunkt i neurovidenskab, kompleksitetsforskning og psykedelika-forskning konceptualiserer de terapeutisk forandring som en trefaset proces: perturbation, reorganisering og konsolidering. Psykedelika eksemplificerer denne mekanisme ved at destabilisere indgroede mønstre midlertidigt, hvilket øger fleksibilitet til reorganisering. Helbredelse omrammes som øget sammenhæng og adaptiv kapacitet på tværs af funktionelle domæner, ikke blot symptomreduktion. Modellen generaliserer på tværs af terapeutiske modaliteter og har implikationer for klinisk praksis og forskningsdesign.

items.title: Esketamine in Treatment-Resistant Depression: Clinical and Translational Perspectives.

summaries.en: This mini-review synthesizes clinical and translational evidence on intranasal esketamine for treatment-resistant depression. The NMDA receptor antagonist produces rapid antidepressant effects within hours by enhancing glutamatergic signaling and activating the AMPA-BDNF-mTOR pathway involved in synaptic plasticity. Randomized controlled trials show consistent reductions in depressive symptoms, though suicidality effects varied. Common adverse events—transient dissociation, dizziness, modest blood pressure increases—are generally self-limiting. Evidence supports esketamine as an effective rapid-acting intervention for treatment-resistant cases.
summaries.da: Denne oversigtsartikel opsummerer kliniske og translationelle studier af intranasal esketamin til behandlingsresistent depression. NMDA-receptorantagonisten frembringer hurtige antidepressive effekter inden for timer ved at øge glutamaterg signalering og aktivere AMPA-BDNF-mTOR-signalvejen involveret i synaptisk plastisitet. Randomiserede kontrollerede forsøg viser konsistente reduktioner i depressive symptomer, selvom effekter på suicidalitet varierede. Almindelige bivirkninger—forbigående disassociation, svimmelhed, beskeden blodtryksstigning—er typisk forbigående. Evidensen støtter esketamin som en effektiv hurtigtvirkende behandling for behandlingsresistent depression.

items.title: [Illicit use of classic psychedelics and suicidality: A systematic literature review].

summaries.en: This systematic review examined the relationship between illicit use of classic psychedelics (psilocybin, LSD, DMT, mescaline) and suicidality outcomes. Following PRISMA guidelines, researchers searched PubMed-Medline and Scopus databases through March 2026 using targeted keyword sequences. The review aimed to clarify mixed findings in existing literature regarding effects on suicidal ideation, planning, attempts, and completed suicides.
summaries.da: Dette systematiske review undersøgte sammenhængen mellem ulovlig brug af psykedelika (psilocybin, LSD, DMT, meskalin) og selvmordsforsøg. Forskerne søgte efter studier i PubMed-Medline og Scopus-databaser til marts 2026 efter PRISMA-retningslinjerne med strukturerede søgeord. Reviewet søgte at præcisere modstridende resultater i eksisterende litteratur angående påvirkning af selvmordstanker, -planlægning, -forsøg og fuldbyrdede selvmord.

items.title: Reply to "Reading the Signal: What Psychedelic Trials in Depression Still Can't Tell Us".

summaries.en: This reply addresses methodological critiques of psychedelic depression trials. Without access to the full abstract, the response likely defends trial design choices and discusses what current evidence can and cannot establish regarding psychedelics' efficacy in treating depression.
summaries.da: Dette svar behandler metodologiske kritikpunkter af psykedelika-forsøg ved depression. Uden adgang til det fulde abstract forsvarer svaret sandsynligvis valg af forsøgsdesign og diskuterer, hvad nuværende evidens kan og ikke kan fastslå om psykedelikas effektivitet ved depression.

items.title: Q1 2026: Oregon Psilocybin Services Update

summaries.en: Oregon Psilocybin Services released its first Q1 2026 dataset, covering January–March. The report provides data on product sales, client demographics and motivations, safety metrics, and key stakeholders in Oregon's regulated psilocybin services infrastructure. The comprehensive tracker offers insights into the state's operational framework for supervised psilocybin-assisted services.
summaries.da: Oregon Psilocybin Services offentliggjorde sit første datasæt for Q1 2026, der dækker januar–marts. Rapporten indeholder data om produktsalg, klientdemografi og motivationer, sikkerhedsmålinger og vigtige aktører i Oregons infrastruktur for regulerede psykedelika-assisterede tjenester. Trackeren giver indsigt i statens operationelle rammeværk.

items.title: Quality of life and productivity among esketamine responders in a real-world study in Australia and New Zealand.

summaries.en: A 16-week real-world study from Australia and New Zealand examined esketamine nasal spray combined with oral antidepressants in 84 treatment-resistant depression patients. Among 28 responders (33.3%), the analysis found mean improvements of 71.2% in depression severity, 29.5% in quality of life (AQoL-8D), and 11.9% or greater in work productivity (WPAI:SHP). Mental health showed the largest quality-of-life gain (32.9%), while work productivity loss improved most (35.9%).
summaries.da: Et 16-ugers real-world studie fra Australien og New Zealand undersøgte esketamin næsespray kombineret med oral antidepressiva hos 84 patienter med behandlingsresistent depression. Blandt 28 respondenters (33,3%) fandt analysen gennemsnitlige forbedringer på 71,2% i depressionsalvor, 29,5% i livskvalitet (AQoL-8D) og 11,9% eller større i arbejdsproduktivitet (WPAI:SHP). Mental sundhed viste størst livskvalitetsgevinst (32,9%), mens arbejdsproduktivitetstab forbedrades mest (35,9%).

items.title: Time-dependent effects of rapid-acting antidepressants in iPSC-derived neurons from treatment-resistant depression and healthy volunteers.

summaries.en: This study used iPSC-derived cortical neurons from treatment-resistant depression patients and healthy controls to investigate rapid-acting antidepressants including ketamine metabolite HNK, psilocybin, LSD, and DOI. After 6 and 24 hours of exposure, bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing revealed that despite different pharmacological targets, all compounds showed highly correlated gene expression patterns, converging on inflammation, mTORC1 signaling, and cellular growth pathways. HNK demonstrated distinct cell-type-specific effects in excitatory neurons. Results were validated against CSF proteomics from ketamine-treated individuals.
summaries.da: Studiet anvendte iPSC-afledt kortikale neuroner fra patienter med behandlingsresistent depression og raske kontroller til at undersøge hurtigtvirkende antidepressiva inklusiv ketamin-metabolit HNK, psilocybin, LSD og DOI. Efter 6 og 24 timers eksponering viste bulk og single-cell RNA-sekvensering, at alle stoffer på trods af forskellige farmakologiske måls havde højt korreleret genekspression, konvergerende på inflammations-, mTORC1-signalerings- og cellulær vækst-veje. HNK demonstrerede distinkte celletypespeficifikke effekter i excitatoric neuroner. Resultater blev valideret mod cerebrospinalvæske-proteomik fra ketamin-behandlede individer.

items.title: MDMA as an early post-trauma intervention in a translational animal model of PTSD.

summaries.en: A controlled rat study (N=175) examined MDMA's potential to prevent PTSD when administered early after trauma. Predator scent stress-exposed rats received MDMA (2.5–10 mg/kg) or saline at 30 minutes or 24 hours post-trauma. The 10 mg/kg dose significantly reduced anxiety, startle response, and contextual fear when given early or delayed with cue pairing. This dose increased corticosterone, hippocampal glucocorticoid receptors, and markers of neuroplasticity (c-Fos, TPH2, oxytocin). Results suggest psychedelics may prevent chronic PTSD development through neurobiological mechanisms.
summaries.da: Et kontrolleret rattestudie (N=175) undersøgte psykedelikas potentiale til at forebygge PTSD når det gives tidligt efter trauma. Rotter eksponeret for rovdyr-lugtstress fik MDMA (2,5–10 mg/kg) eller saltvandsløsning 30 minutter eller 24 timer efter trauma. Dosen på 10 mg/kg reducerede signifikant angst, startle-respons og kontekstuel frygt når det blev givet tidligt eller forsinket med signal-parring. Denne dosis øgede corticosteron, hippokampale glukokortikoid-receptorer og neuroplasticitetsmærkører (c-Fos, TPH2, oxytocin). Resultaterne tyder på, at psykedelika kan forebygge kronisk PTSD gennem neurobiologiske mekanismer.

items.title: Targeting TLR4/PPARα-mediated neuroinflammation in the prefrontal cortex: S-ketamine and S-HNK rapidly alleviate depression-like behaviors.

summaries.en: This preclinical study investigated how S-ketamine and S-hydroxynorketamine (S-HNK) reduce depression-like behaviors in mice exposed to chronic social stress. Male C57BL/6J mice underwent chronic social defeat stress followed by drug treatment, with behavioral testing (sucrose preference, forced swim, social interaction) and neurochemical analysis. Both compounds rapidly reversed stress-induced depression-like behaviors and restored dopamine, serotonin, and norepinephrine levels in the prefrontal cortex. The mechanisms involved suppression of TLR4-mediated neuroinflammation and increased PPARα signaling, reducing pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α). Viral overexpression of TLR4 blocked these therapeutic effects, confirming TLR4 as a critical target.
summaries.da: Dette dyreforsøg undersøgte, hvordan S-ketamin og S-hydroxynorketamin (S-HNK) reducerer depressionsagtige adfærdsmønstre hos mus udsatte for kronisk social stress. Mandlige C57BL/6J-mus blev underkastet kronisk social nederlagsstress efterfulgt af medicinalbehandling med adfærdstestning og neurochemisk analyse. Begge stoffer vendte hurtigt stress-inducerede depressionsagtige symptomer og gendannede dopamin-, serotonin- og noradrenalin-niveauer i præfrontal cortex. Mekanismerne omfattede suppression af TLR4-medieret neuroinflammation og øget PPARα-signalering, hvilket reducerede pro-inflammatoriske cytokiner. Viral overexpression af TLR4 blokerede disse terapeutiske effekter og bekræftede TLR4 som kritisk target.

items.title: Real-World Effectiveness and Cost-Differential of Intranasal Esketamine Versus Intramuscular Ketamine.

summaries.en: A retrospective study of 179 Veterans with treatment-resistant depression compared intramuscular (IM) ketamine to intranasal (IN) esketamine across eight treatments. IM ketamine showed non-inferiority to IN esketamine for depression (PHQ-9 difference: 0.04 points) and PTSD symptoms, with comparable adverse events and hospitalizations. Notably, IM ketamine cost $647 per treatment course versus $6,069 for IN esketamine, suggesting it may be a cost-effective alternative expanding access to ketamine treatment.
summaries.da: Et retrospektivt studie af 179 veteraner med behandlingsresistent depression sammenlignede intramuskulær (IM) ketamin med intranasal (IN) esketamin over otte behandlinger. IM ketamin var ikke-inferior til IN esketamin for depression (PHQ-9-forskel: 0,04 point) og PTSD-symptomer, med sammenlignelige bivirkninger og indlæggelser. Væsentligt kostede IM ketamin $647 pr. behandlingskursus mod $6.069 for IN esketamin, hvilket tyder på, at det kan være et omkostningseffektivt alternativ, der udvider adgangen til ketaminbehandling.

items.title: Real-world outcomes of intranasal esketamine and intravenous ketamine induction therapy for treatment-resistant depression in a community clinic: a retrospective cohort study.

summaries.en: Retrospective cohort study (n=63) comparing intranasal esketamine (n=37) and IV ketamine (n=26) for treatment-resistant depression in a community clinic. Both groups showed similar baseline depression severity (PHQ-9 ~18) and comparable improvements (mean reduction ~10 points). Response rates were 64.9% vs 69.2%, remission 32.4% vs 23.1%, with no statistically significant differences. Induction completion exceeded 90% for both groups.
summaries.da: Retrospektivt kohortestudie (n=63) sammenlignende intranasal esketamin (n=37) og IV ketamin (n=26) til behandlingsresistent depression i klinik. Begge grupper viste lignende baseline-depression (PHQ-9 ~18) og sammenlignelige forbedringer (gennemsnitlig reduktion ~10 point). Respons var 64,9% vs 69,2%, remission 32,4% vs 23,1%, uden statistisk signifikante forskelle. Induktionsgennemførelsesrate oversteg 90% for begge grupper.

items.title: Rapid clinical and EEG microstate changes 24 h after intranasal esketamine in major depressive disorder with suicidal ideation: a prospective paired study.

summaries.en: A prospective paired study of 31 patients with major depressive disorder and suicidal ideation examined effects of intranasal esketamine added to standard care. Clinical assessment and resting-state EEG were conducted at baseline and 24 hours post-administration. HAMD-17 scores improved significantly (25.32±1.37 to 20.55±1.52, n=22, FDR=0.0016). While power spectral density showed no significant changes across frequency bands, microstate analysis revealed early alterations in microstate D occurrence and coverage, plus modified transition patterns. Results indicate rapid clinical improvement correlates with specific EEG microstate changes rather than broadband power modifications.
summaries.da: En prospektiv paired-studie med 31 patienter med major depressiv lidelse og selvmordstanker undersøgte effekten af intranasal esketamin som supplement til standardbehandling. Klinisk vurdering og hvilende EEG blev udført ved baseline og 24 timer efter administration. HAMD-17-scores forbedrede sig signifikant (25,32±1,37 til 20,55±1,52, n=22, FDR=0,0016). Mens power spektral densitet viste ingen signifikante ændringer på tværs af frekvensbånd, afslørede mikrostattilstandsanalyse tidlige ændringer i mikrostattilstand D's forekomst og dækning samt ændrede overgangsmønstre. Resultaterne indikerer, at hurtig klinisk forbedring korrelerer med specifikke EEG-mikrostattilstandsændringer snarere end bred-bånd-kraftmodifikationer.

items.title: Intranasal esketamine plus oral antidepressant for treatment-resistant depression: acute induction and maintenance relapse-prevention outcomes in a systematic review and meta-analysis.

summaries.en: A meta-analysis of six randomized controlled trials (1,836 participants) evaluated intranasal esketamine combined with oral antidepressants for treatment-resistant depression. In acute induction (4 weeks), esketamine showed modest but significant symptom reduction (MADRS -2.99 points) with rapid effects by day 2. Response and remission rates improved (RR 1.44 and 1.52, respectively). Maintenance treatment reduced relapse risk. Evidence quality was moderate to low due to small effect sizes and heterogeneity.
summaries.da: En metaanalyse af seks randomiserede kontrollerede studier (1.836 deltagere) evaluerede intranasal esketamin kombineret med oralt antidepressivum ved behandlingsresistent depression. I akut induktion (4 uger) viste esketamin beskedne, men signifikante symptomreduktioner (MADRS -2,99 point) med hurtige effekter på dag 2. Respons- og remissionsrater forbedres (RR 1,44 og 1,52). Vedligeholdelsesbeh. reducerede tilbagefaldrisiko. Bevisernes kvalitet var moderat til lav på grund af små effektstørrelser.

items.title: Social hierarchy shapes behavioral and transcriptional responses to chronic stress and ketamine in male mice.

summaries.en: This study examined how social hierarchy influences stress responses and ketamine treatment in group-housed male mice using continuous behavioral tracking over 11 days in a seminatural environment. Dominant mice showed greater behavioral disruption from chronic stress, including fragmented rest and altered social interactions. A single ketamine dose reversed these effects in dominant individuals. mRNA sequencing of the medial prefrontal cortex and ventral hippocampus identified 141 differentially expressed genes in ketamine-treated dominant mice, revealing hierarchy-dependent transcriptional responses to stress and treatment.
summaries.da: Studiet undersøgte, hvordan social hierarki påvirker stressresponser og ketamin-behandling hos gruppeboende hanmuse ved kontinuerlig adfærdssporing over 11 dage i et semi-naturalistisk miljø. Dominante mus viste større adfærdsforstyrrelser fra kronisk stress, herunder fragmenteret hvile og ændret social interaktion. En enkelt ketamindosis vendte disse effekter hos dominante individer. mRNA-sekvensering af medial præfrontal cortex og ventral hippocampus identificerede 141 forskelligt udtrykte gener hos ketamin-behandlede dominante mus, hvilket afslører hierarki-afhængige transkriptomiske responser på stress og psykedelika-behandling.

items.title: Treating addiction with an addictive drug: the ketamine paradox revisited.

summaries.en: A structured narrative review examined ketamine's therapeutic potential for substance use disorders (SUDs) and treatment-resistant depression across PubMed, Scopus, PsycINFO, and Web of Science databases. Small-to-moderate Phase 2 trials show ketamine combined with psychotherapy reduces craving and increases abstinent days in alcohol and cocaine use disorders. However, heterogeneous dosing, comparators, and follow-up periods limit generalizability. Relapse prevention effects remain inconsistent. While ketamine's glutamatergic mechanisms show neuroplastic promise, concerns about abuse liability persist, requiring careful risk-benefit evaluation.
summaries.da: Et struktureret narrativt review undersøgte ketamins terapeutiske potentiale for substansmisbrug og behandlingsresistent depression på tværs af større databaser. Små-moderate fase 2-forsøg viser, at ketamin kombineret med psykoterapi reducerer trang og øger abstinente dage ved alkohol- og kokainmisbrug. Heterogene doseringsstrategier, kontrolbetingelser og opfølgningsperioder begrænser imidlertid generaliserbarhed. Effekter på tilbagefaldspræventionen er inkonsistente. Selvom ketamins glutamaterge mekanismer viser neuroplastisk potentiale, kræver bekymringer om misbrug omhyggelig risiko-benefit-vurdering.

items.title: Implementation factors shaping British Columbia's drug decriminalization pilot: A systematic review with narrative synthesis.

summaries.en: British Columbia's 2023 drug decriminalization pilot removed criminal penalties for possession of up to 2.5 g of opioids, cocaine, methamphetamine, and MDMA, aiming to address substance use as a public health issue. This systematic review of 27 studies (published May 2022–February 2026) identified four key implementation barriers: restrictive pilot design (including the 2.5 g threshold misaligned with actual use patterns), communication gaps between public and sectors, inadequate frontline training, and insufficient funding and infrastructure. The pilot ended in January 2026 after penalties were reintroduced in May 2024.
summaries.da: British Columbias dekriminaliserings-pilotprojekt fra 2023 fjernede strafferetlige konsekvenser for besiddelse af op til 2,5 g opioder, kokain, metamfetamin og MDMA med sigte på at behandle stofforbrug som et sundhedspolitisk spørgsmål. Denne systematiske litteraturgennemgang af 27 studier (publiceret maj 2022–februar 2026) identificerede fire vigtige implementeringshindringer: restriktivt projektdesign (inklusive 2,5 g-tærskelen, der ikke stemmer overens med faktiske brugsmønstre), kommunikationsbrist mellem offentlighed og sektorer, utilstrækkelig uddannelse af frontlinjemedarbejdere og uuaustadig finansiering og infrastruktur. Projektet endte i januar 2026, efter at straffe blev genindført i maj 2024.

items.title: Pα+ Psychedelic Bulletin #228: Inside the Lilly-Atai Deal; An Update on the GH-AtaiBeckley Patent Standoff; Field Reacts to FDA’s Guidance; Resilient Readies Resubmission

summaries.en: This Psychedelic Alpha bulletin covers three major industry developments: details of Eli Lilly's acquisition of AtaiBeckley (based on anonymous sources), an ongoing patent dispute between GH Research and AtaiBeckley, reactions from the field to FDA guidance on psychedelics, and Resilient Therapeutics' planned resubmission of a regulatory application.
summaries.da: Dette Psychedelic Alpha bulletin dækker tre vigtige brancheopdateringer: detaljer om Eli Lillys opkøb af AtaiBeckley (baseret på anonyme kilder), en igangværende patentkonflikt mellem GH Research og AtaiBeckley, reaktioner fra fagmiljøet på FDAs vejledning om psykedelika, og Resilient Therapeutics' planlagte genindgivelse af en regulatorisk ansøgning.

items.title: Adolescent exposure to the psychedelic 25C-NBOMe in rats induces lasting competitive avoidance through disrupted hippocampal-prefrontal synchrony.

summaries.en: Repeated adolescent exposure to 25C-NBOMe, a serotonergic psychedelic, induced lasting competitive avoidance in male rats, whereas adult exposure did not. Multisite neural recordings showed disrupted default mode network synchrony, particularly reduced theta coherence between ventral hippocampus and orbitofrontal cortex. Chemogenetic manipulation of this circuit causally linked the neural disruption to behavioral change, suggesting psychedelics during adolescence can durably alter social functioning through disrupted brain synchrony.
summaries.da: Gentagen eksponering for psykedelikaet 25C-NBOMe under adolescensen fremkaldte varig konkurrenceafvigelse hos mandlige rotter, mens vokseneksponering ikke gjorde. Multisite neurale målinger viste forstyrret default mode network-synkronisering, særligt reduceret theta-kohærens mellem ventral hippocampus og orbitofrontal cortex. Kemogenetisk manipulation af denne kredsløb viste kausal sammenhæng mellem neurale forstyrrelser og adfærdsændringer, hvilket tyder på at psykedelika under adolescensen kan varigt ændre social funktionering.

items.title: Antidepressant-like effects of ketamine involve CX

summaries.en: A study investigating ketamine's antidepressant mechanisms reveals that CX pathways play a role in its rapid and sustained effects. As a non-competitive NMDA receptor antagonist, ketamine produces antidepressant responses faster than conventional treatments, though the molecular basis remained unclear. This research advances understanding of how psychedelics and dissociative compounds influence mood regulation at the cellular level.
summaries.da: En undersøgelse af ketamins antidepressive virkningsmekanismer viser, at CX-veje spiller en rolle i dets hurtige og vedvarende effekter. Som ikke-konkurrencebegrænsende NMDA-receptorantagonist producerer ketamin antidepressiv respons hurtigere end konventionel behandling, selvom det molekylære grundlag tidligere var uklart. Forskningen øger forståelsen af, hvordan psykedelika og dissociative stoffer påvirker humørregulering på cellulært niveau.

items.title: Ketamine-induced analgesia and dissociation show distinct behavioral and neural correlates.

summaries.en: A within-subject fMRI study (n=37) examined whether ketamine's analgesic and dissociative effects rely on distinct neural mechanisms. Participants received intravenous ketamine (0.4 mg/kg bolus + infusion) or placebo while experiencing calibrated thermal pain. Ketamine produced both analgesia and dissociation, but these effects showed separable neural signatures: pain relief correlated with reduced insula activity and pain-predictive patterns, while dissociation selectively involved decreased default mode network connectivity, suggesting analgesia does not require dissociation.
summaries.da: En within-subject fMRI-undersøgelse (n=37) undersøgte, om ketamins analgetiske og dissociative effekter afhænger af forskellige neurale mekanismer. Deltagere modtog intravenøs ketamin (0,4 mg/kg bolus + infusion) eller placebo under kalibreret termisk smerte. Ketamin producerede både smertestilling og dissociation, men effekterne viste adskilte neurale signaturer: smertelindring korrelerede med reduceret insula-aktivitet og smerteprediktive mønstre, mens dissociation selektivt involverede nedsat default mode network-konnektivitet, hvilket tyder på, at smertestilling ikke kræver dissociation.

items.title: Clinical guidance on the use of esketamine nasal spray for patients with treatment resistant depression: A European Delphi consensus report.

summaries.en: A 3-round Delphi consensus panel of 30 European psychiatrists established clinical guidance for esketamine nasal spray in treatment-resistant depression. Key findings: modest symptom improvements during acute phase (4-12 weeks) justify continuation, particularly in patients with long disease duration or multiple prior treatment failures. Weekly 84 mg dosing is recommended to optimize outcomes. Continuation phase monitoring should track residual symptoms, functional recovery, and comorbidities. Dose escalation is supported for persistent residual symptoms, with maintenance treatment duration (≥12 months) depending on clinical worsening upon tapering.
summaries.da: Et 3-runders Delphi-konsensuspanel af 30 europæiske psykiatere etablerede klinisk vejledning for esketamin-næsespray ved behandlingsresistent depression. Vigtige fund: beskedne symptomforbedringer i akut fase (4-12 uger) retfærdiggør fortsættelse, især hos patienter med lang sygdomsvarighed eller tidligere svigt på flere behandlinger. Ugentlig 84 mg dosering anbefales for at optimere resultater. Overvågning i fortsættelsesfasen bør fokusere på resterende symptomer, funktionel bedring og komorbiditeter. Doseskalering understøttes ved vedvarende restsymptomer, med vedligeholdelsestrategiens varighed (≥12 måneder) afhængig af klinisk forværring ved nedtrapning.

items.title: Emerging pharmacological and neuromodulation interventions for suicidal ideation and behaviour.

summaries.en: A narrative review of 34 studies (22 pharmacological, 12 neuromodulation) examined emerging interventions for suicidal ideation and attempts. Controlled trials showed improvements within days to weeks, with some evidence suggesting effects independent of depression changes. NMDA-related drugs, opioid-system modulators, ayahuasca, and pimavanserin showed encouraging results, while vortioxetine and zolpidem showed smaller effects. Observational data supported associations with folic acid, benztropine, and testosterone initiation in transgender adults.
summaries.da: Et narrativt review af 34 studier (22 farmakologiske, 12 neuromodulation) undersøgte nye interventioner mod suicidal ideation og selvmordsforsøg. Kontrollerede forsøg viste forbedringer inden for dage til uger, med delvist uafhængige effekter fra depression. NMDA-relaterede lægemidler, psykedelika, opioid-system modulatorer og pimavanserin viste lovende resultater, mens vortioxetin og zolpidem viste mindre effekter. Observationsdata understøttede sammenknytning med folinsyre, benztropin og testosteron hos transkønnede.

items.title: Case Report: Intranasal esketamine and accelerated intermittent theta-burst stimulation for severe treatment-resistant depression with suicidal ideation.

summaries.en: Case report of a 29-year-old woman with severe treatment-resistant depression and high-risk suicidal ideation treated with combined intranasal esketamine (84 mg) and accelerated intermittent theta-burst stimulation (10 sessions over 4 days, 6,000 pulses targeting left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex). Baseline depression scores: PHQ-9=15, HAMD=27, BDI=41. Following treatment, scores improved to PHQ-9=11, HAMD=20, BDI=28, with reported reduction in suicidal ideation. Two-week follow-up showed sustained improvement (PHQ-9=8, HAMD=17, BDI=23). Limited clinical reports exist on this combined accelerated inpatient approach in high-risk patients.
summaries.da: Kasuistik af 29-årig kvinde med alvorlig behandlingsresistent depression og høj selvmordsmæssig risiko behandlet med kombineret intranasal esketamin (84 mg) og accelereret intermittent theta-burst stimulation (10 sessioner over 4 dage, 6.000 pulser mod venstre dorsolateral præfrontal cortex). Baseline depressionsscorer: PHQ-9=15, HAMD=27, BDI=41. Efter behandling forbedredes scorerne til PHQ-9=11, HAMD=20, BDI=28 med rapporteret reduktion i selvmordstanker. To-ugers opfølgning viste vedvarende forbedring (PHQ-9=8, HAMD=17, BDI=23). Begrænsede kliniske rapporter eksisterer om denne kombinerede accelererede indlæggelsestilgang hos højrisikopatienter.

items.title: Integrated 5-HT

summaries.en: Study using neural stem cell-derived in vitro model investigated how serotonergic psychedelics promote neuroplasticity. Researchers tested tryptamines, phenethylamines, and ergolines alongside ketamine and TrkB agonists, measuring dendritogenesis, synaptogenesis, gene induction, and BDNF expression. TrkB silencing blocked dendritogenic effects of psychedelics, suggesting this pathway links acute effects to longer-term neuroplastic responses.
summaries.da: Studie med in vitro-model udviklet fra neurale stamceller undersøgte, hvordan serotonerg psykedelika fremmer neuroplasticitet. Forskerne testede tryptaminer, phenethylaminer og ergolines sammen med ketamin og TrkB-agonister og målte dendritogenese, synaptogenese, genaktivering og BDNF-udtryk. TrkB-stilleslukning blokerede psykedelikas dendritogene effekter og tyder på, at denne vej forbinder akutte effekter til længerevarende neuroplastiske reaktioner.

items.title: Serum brain-derived neurotrophic factor following oral esketamine in treatment-resistant depression: Results from a randomized placebo-controlled trial.

summaries.en: A randomized placebo-controlled trial examined serum BDNF levels in 54 treatment-resistant depression patients receiving six weeks of daily oral esketamine (90 mg/day) versus placebo. While the primary outcome showed no difference between groups, BDNF increased over time regardless of treatment condition. Notably, BDNF changes did not correlate with depression symptom improvement in the esketamine group, questioning BDNF as a biomarker for antidepressant response in this dosing regimen.
summaries.da: Et randomiseret placebo-kontrolleret forsøg undersøgte serumkoncentrationer af BDNF hos 54 patienter med behandlingsresistent depression, der modtog seks ugers daglig oral esketamin (90 mg/dag) eller placebo. Selvom primærudfald viste ingen forskel mellem grupperne, steg BDNF over tid uafhængigt af behandling. Vigtigst: BDNF-ændringer korrelerede ikke med depressionsymptomer i esketamingruppen, hvilket sætter spørgsmålstegn ved BDNF som biomarkør for psykedelikas antidepressive effekt ved denne dosering.

items.title: UK's regulatory and legislative double standards in the treatment of psychedelics and drugs for assisted suicide.

summaries.en: This editorial examines regulatory inconsistencies in UK drug policy. It argues that assisted suicide medications would receive expedited approval despite limited evidence, while psychedelics face restrictive scheduling despite promising international clinical research. The author advocates for consistent regulatory standards: assisted suicide drugs should undergo standard approval procedures, and psychedelics should be rescheduled to facilitate further clinical investigation.
summaries.da: Dette redaktionelt stykke undersøger regulatoriske inkonsistenser i britisk narkotikapolitik. Det argumenterer for, at medicin til assisteret selvmord ville modtage hurtigspor-godkendelse på trods af begrænset evidens, mens psykedelika møder restriktiv klassificering trods lovende international klinisk forskning. Forfatteren argumenterer for konsistente regulatoriske standarder: assisteret selvmord-medicin bør gennemgå standard godkendelsesprocedurer, og psykedelika bør omklassificeres for at facilitere yderligere klinisk undersøgelse.

items.title: Breaking: World’s Largest Pharmaceutical Company, Eli Lilly, Acquires 5-MeO-DMT Developer AtaiBeckley for Up to $3.8 billion

summaries.en: Eli Lilly, a major pharmaceutical company, has acquired AtaiBeckley, a developer of 5-MeO-DMT-based therapeutics, for up to $3.8 billion. This acquisition reflects growing pharmaceutical interest in psychedelics as potential treatments, though clinical efficacy and regulatory pathways remain under investigation.
summaries.da: Eli Lilly, et større medicinalselskab, har erhvervet AtaiBeckley, en udvikler af 5-MeO-DMT-baserede behandlinger, for op til 3,8 milliarder dollars. Opkøbet afspejler stigende farmaceutisk interesse i psykedelika som potentielle terapier, selvom klinisk effektivitet og regulatoriske veje stadig undersøges.

items.title: Psilocybin's effect on human brain synaptic plasticity.

summaries.en: A randomized study of 15 healthy participants examined whether a single psilocybin dose (0.3 mg/kg) increases synaptic density using [¹¹C]UCB-J PET imaging at baseline and one week post-dose. While no significant overall increase in synaptic vesicle density occurred, participants in a therapeutic-like setting reported more intense mystical experiences, greater psychological benefits, and larger synaptic density increases than those dosed in an MRI scanner. These results suggest environmental context modulates psilocybin's neuroplastic effects.
summaries.da: En randomiseret undersøgelse af 15 raske deltagere undersøgte, om en enkelt psilocybin-dosis (0,3 mg/kg) øger synaptisk densitet ved hjælp af [¹¹C]UCB-J PET-billeddannelse ved baseline og en uge efter dosering. Selvom der ikke blev påvist signifikant samlet stigning i synaptisk vesikel-densitet, rapporterede deltagere i terapilignende miljø mere intense mystiske oplevelser, større psykologiske fordele og større stigning i synaptisk densitet end dem, der blev doseret i en MR-scanner. Resultaterne tyder på, at miljøkontekst modulerer psilocybins neuroplastiske virkninger.

items.title: Ketamine use disorder: A case report.

summaries.en: This case report documents ketamine use disorder in a clinical setting. The study presents clinical observations of ketamine dependence, contributing to the understanding of problematic use patterns and potential diagnostic criteria for ketamine use disorder.
summaries.da: Denne kasuistik dokumenterer ketamin-misbrug i klinisk sammenhæng. Studiet præsenterer kliniske observationer af ketaminafhængighed og bidrager til forståelsen af problematiske brugsmønstre og potentielle diagnostiske kriterier for ketaminmisbrug.

items.title: Psychedelics Trials and Outcomes- A Closer Look.

summaries.en: This PubMed article examines clinical trial outcomes for psychedelics, analyzing study designs and efficacy data across therapeutic applications. The review synthesizes evidence from multiple trials to evaluate safety and effectiveness profiles, providing a systematic overview of the current research landscape in psychedelic-assisted treatments.
summaries.da: Denne PubMed-artikel undersøger kliniske forsøgsresultater med psykedelika og analyserer studiedesign og effektivitetsdata på tværs af terapeutiske anvendelser. Reviewet syntetiserer evidens fra multiple forsøg for at evaluere sikkerhed og effektivitet, og giver et systematisk overblik over det nuværende forskningslandskab inden for psykedelika-assisteret behandling.

items.title: Psychedelics Trials and Outcomes-A Closer Look.

summaries.en: This PubMed-indexed review examines clinical trial methodologies and outcomes in psychedelic research. The article provides a systematic analysis of study designs used to evaluate therapeutic efficacy of psychedelics across psychiatric conditions, offering researchers and clinicians insights into evidence quality and trial standardization in the field.
summaries.da: Dette PubMed-indekserede review undersøger kliniske forsøgsmetodologier og resultater inden for psykedelika-forskning. Artiklen giver en systematisk analyse af studiedesign anvendt til vurdering af psykedelikas terapeutiske effekt ved psykiatriske tilstande og tilbyder indsigt i evidenskvalitet og forsøgsstandardisering.

items.title: From Schedule I to the Clinic-Insights Into Psychedelic Drug Development From GHB.

summaries.en: This viewpoint examines sodium oxybate (GHB) as a case study for how Schedule I substances, including psychedelics, can navigate regulatory pathways toward clinical approval. The analysis offers insights into potential development routes for psychedelic therapeutics.
summaries.da: Denne artikel analyserer natriumoxybat (GHB) som eksempel på, hvordan Schedule I-stoffer, herunder psykedelika, kan følge regulatoriske veje mod klinisk godkendelse. Analysen belyser potentielle udviklingsveje for psykedelisk terapi.

items.title: Micro-phenomenology of immersion and perceived presences under DMT.

summaries.en: A micro-phenomenological study examined immersion and perceived presences under DMT in 23 participants receiving 20 mg intravenous DMT during fMRI-EEG recording. Detailed interviews identified 125 phenomenological categories describing structural dimensions including sensory faculties, spatial organization, and social relatedness. Analysis revealed hierarchical development: bodily effects preceded visual and auditory phenomena, with perceived presences emerging only after multisensory integration and 3D spatial characteristics developed. Presences varied in sensory modality, complexity, and relational mode, suggesting immersion under psychedelics is a dynamic, constructive process with identifiable structural features.
summaries.da: Et mikro-fænomenologisk studie undersøgte immersion og oplevede præsenser under DMT hos 23 deltagere, der modtog 20 mg intravenøs DMT under fMRI-EEG-registrering. Detaljerede interviews identificerede 125 fænomenologiske kategorier beskrivende strukturelle dimensioner som sensoriske fakulteter, rumlig organisering og social relationalitet. Analysen afslørede hierarkisk udvikling: legemlige effekter gik forud for visuelle og auditive fænomener, og oplevede præsenser opstod først efter multisensorisk integration og 3D-rumlige karakteristika var udviklet. Præsenser varierede i sensorisk modalitet, kompleksitet og relational tilstand, hvilket indikerer immersion under psykedelika som en dynamisk, konstruktiv proces med identificerbare strukturelle træk.

items.title: Ionic Homeostasis Failure in Major Depressive Disorder: Ion Channel Mechanisms, Excitation-Inhibition Imbalance, and Precision Therapeutics.

summaries.en: A new framework proposes that major depressive disorder involves disrupted ionic homeostasis across neuronal and glial ion channels, affecting calcium, potassium, and chloride balance. Genetic factors, chronic stress, and neuroinflammation converge to cause excitation-inhibition imbalance and network instability. The review identifies key ion channels (CACNA1C, TREK-1, KCNQ) and discusses how ketamine, chloride-restoring approaches, and precision biomarkers may inform targeted therapeutics.
summaries.da: En ny teoretisk ramme foreslår, at depression involverer forstyrret ionisk homeostase i neuronale og gliale ionkanaler, som påvirker calcium-, kalium- og chloridbalance. Genetiske faktorer, kronisk stress og neuroinflammation konvergerer og forårsager ubalance mellem excitation og inhibition samt netværksinstabilitet. Reviewet identificerer centrale ionkanaler (CACNA1C, TREK-1, KCNQ) og diskuterer, hvordan ketamin, chloridgenoprettende strategier og præcisionsbiomarkører kan informere målrettet behandling.

items.title: Erratum to: Calcium/Calmodulin-Dependent Protein Kinase II and Eukaryotic Elongation Factor 2 Kinase Pathways Mediate the Antidepressant Action of Ketamine.

summaries.en: This erratum concerns a study examining ketamine's antidepressant mechanisms. The research investigated calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II and eukaryotic elongation factor 2 kinase pathways as mediators of ketamine's therapeutic effects. The correction addresses technical details in the original publication without modifying core findings.
summaries.da: Denne rettelse vedrører en studie af ketamins antidepressive virkningsmekanismer. Forskningen undersøgte calcium/calmodulin-afhængige proteinkinase II og eukaryotisk elongationsfaktor 2 kinase-veje som mediatorer af ketamins terapeutiske effekter. Rettelsen omhandler tekniske detaljer i den oprindelige publikation uden at ændre hovedresultaterne.

items.title: Acute Hallucinogen Intoxication Following Ingestion of a Commercially Available Mushroom Extract Product: A Case Report.

summaries.en: Case report of an 18-year-old female presenting to emergency care with acute hallucinogen intoxication after consuming a commercially available mushroom extract product. Symptoms included severe anxiety, agitation, visual and auditory hallucinations, paranoid ideation, tachycardia, and dilated pupils. The case highlights diagnostic challenges clinicians face when psilocybin-containing products reach consumers through unregulated retail channels with ambiguous labeling.
summaries.da: Kasuistik om en 18-årig kvinde, der blev indlagt på skadestuen med akut hallucinogenintoksikation efter indtagelse af et kommercielt tilgængeligt svampeekstraktprodukt. Symptomerne omfattede svær angst, agitation, visuelle og auditive hallucinationer samt paranoid ideation. Sagen illustrerer de diagnostiske udfordringer, klinikere står over for, når psykedelika-holdige produkter når forbrugerne gennem uregulerede detailkanaler med uklar mærkning.

items.title: Psychedelic therapy at the end of life: unexplored alternative to assisted suicide in the UK.

summaries.en: An editorial argues that psychedelics warrant rescheduling to enable research into their therapeutic potential for end-of-life care in the UK. Evidence suggests psychedelics can reduce existential distress and suicidality in terminally ill patients, positioning them as a possible adjunct to palliative care. The author advocates exploring this avenue before institutionalizing assisted suicide.
summaries.da: En redaktionel artikel argumenterer for, at psykedelika bør omklassificeres for at muliggøre forskning i deres terapeutiske potentiale i palliativ behandling ved livets slutning i Storbritannien. Evidens tyder på, at psykedelika kan reducere eksistentiel angst og selvmordstanker hos terminalt syge patienter og positionerer dem som mulig supplement til palliativ pleje. Forfatteren foreslår at udforske denne mulighed før assisted suicide institutionaliseres.

items.title: Combined DMT-harmine formulation reduces negative self-referential emotions during social self-evaluation: a randomized placebo-controlled trial in healthy volunteers.

summaries.en: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial (N=28 healthy males) examined whether a combined DMT-harmine formulation reduces negative self-referential emotions. Participants rated emotional responses while listening to recordings of their own singing versus control vocals using visual analogue scales and the Experiential Shame Scale. The DMT-harmine combination significantly reduced embarrassment during self-evaluation compared to placebo, but harmine alone showed no significant effect. Results suggest psychedelics may modulate self-referential processing relevant to psychiatric conditions.
summaries.da: Et randomiseret, dobbeltblindet, placebo-kontrolleret crossover-studie (N=28 sunde mænd) undersøgte, hvorvidt en kombineret DMT-harmin-formulering reducerer negative selv-relaterede følelser. Deltagerne vurderede følelsesmæssige reaktioner mens de lyttede til optagelser af deres egen sang versus kontrolsang ved hjælp af visuelle analoge skalaer og Experiential Shame Scale. DMT-harmin-kombinationen reducerede signifikant skam under selvvurdering sammenlignet med placebo, mens harmin alene viste ingen signifikant effekt. Resultaterne tyder på, at psykedelika kan modulere selv-relateret processering relevant for psykiatriske tilstande.

items.title: Acceptability and safety of two sequential doses of psilocybin in bipolar II depression: protocol for an open-label single-arm feasibility study.

summaries.en: An open-label feasibility study investigating psilocybin-assisted therapy for bipolar II depression with suicidal ideation. The phase II trial will enroll 10 participants receiving up to two 25 mg oral psilocybin doses, spaced 4 weeks apart, combined with mindfulness-based cognitive-behavioral therapy. Study aims to assess acceptability, safety, and treatment outcomes in a population typically excluded from psychedelics research due to safety concerns.
summaries.da: En åben fase II-studie undersøger psykedelika-assisteret terapi med psilocybin for bipolar II depression med selvmordstanker. Studiet inkluderer 10 deltagere, som får op til to doser á 25 mg psilocybin med 4 ugers mellemrum samt psykologisk terapi baseret på mindfulness og kognitiv adfærdsterapi. Formålet er at evaluere accept, sikkerhed og behandlingseffekt i en population typisk ekskluderet fra psykedelika-forskning.

items.title: Longitudinal dream-content shift and void-like dissociative phenomenology around outpatient ketamine infusions in chronic low back pain: a case report.

summaries.en: Case report documenting dream content changes in a 48-year-old patient with chronic low back pain receiving five low-dose ketamine infusions (15 mg) in 2014. Analysis of 50 masked, randomly selected dreams from 360 documented narratives (2009-2025) using pre-specified coding by two independent raters revealed decreased obstruction motifs post-ketamine and increased social-interaction themes. Patient reported void-like dissociative phenomenology during infusions. Study makes no efficacy claims but suggests psychedelics may associate with longer-term shifts in imaginal processes.
summaries.da: Kasuistik dokumenterende ændringer i drømmIndhold hos 48-årigt patient med kronisk lændesmerter, som modtog fem lavdosis ketamininfusioner (15 mg) i 2014. Analyse af 50 maskerede, tilfældigt valgte drømme fra 360 dokumenterede narrativer (2009-2025) med foruddefineret kodning af to uafhængige bedømmere viste nedsat obstruktionsmotiver efter ketamin og øget sociale-interaktions temaer. Patient rapporterede tomhedsagtig dissociativ fænomenologi under infusioner. Studiet gør ingen effektivitetskrav, men indikerer at psykedelika kan associeres med længerevarende skift i imaginative processer.

items.title: Keeping Up with the Feds: From FDA to HRSA, Washington Backs Psychedelics

summaries.en: U.S. federal agencies including the FDA and HRSA are increasingly supporting psychedelics research and development. The article tracks regulatory shifts and institutional backing for clinical programs, reflecting growing governmental recognition of potential therapeutic applications in psychiatry and mental health treatment.
summaries.da: Amerikanske føderale myndigheder som FDA og HRSA bakker i stigende grad psykedelika-forskning og udvikling. Artiklen sporer regulatoriske ændringer og institutionel støtte til kliniske programmer, hvilket afspejler voksende statslig anerkendelse af potentielle terapeutiske anvendelser inden for psykiatri og mental sundhed.

items.title: Enhancing plasticity to treat depression and other central nervous system diseases using event-driven pharmacology.

summaries.en: Event-driven pharmacology (EDP) proposes that acute effects of plastogens—drugs causing transient receptor binding—drive sustained neuroplastic changes outlasting drug exposure. Unlike traditional occupancy-driven models targeting stable receptor occupancy, plastogens including ketamine and classical psychedelics produce long-lasting neural plasticity and metaplasticity from single or intermittent doses. This review suggests optimizing plastogens for conventional target occupancy may paradoxically reduce therapeutic benefits while increasing side effects, challenging standard psychopharmacology approaches to depression and CNS disorders.
summaries.da: Event-driven farmakologi (EDP) foreslår, at akutte effekter af plasogener—stoffer med transiøre receptorbindinger—driver vedvarende neuroplastiske ændringer, der varer længere end stofeksponering. I modsætning til traditionelle modeller målrettet stabil receptorbesat, producerer plasogener som ketamin og klassiske psykedelika lang varende neuroplasticitet fra enkelte eller intermitterende doser. Denne artikel foreslår, at optimering af plasogener efter konventionel receptorbesat paradoksalt kan reducere terapeutiske fordele og øge bivirkninger, hvilket stiller spørgsmålstegn ved standardmetoder i psykofarmakologi for depression og CNS-sygdomme.

items.title: FDA Issues Final Psychedelics Guidance, Schedules September Hearing on the Future of Psychedelic Therapies

summaries.en: The FDA released final guidance in 2023 on clinical investigations of psychedelics, covering nonclinical research, chemistry, manufacturing, controls, clinical study design, and abuse potential assessment. After three years of stakeholder feedback review, the agency scheduled a September hearing to discuss the future of psychedelic therapies, signaling movement toward structured regulatory frameworks for this emerging field.
summaries.da: FDA udsendte endelig vejledning i 2023 om kliniske undersøgelser af psykedelika, omfattende præklinisk forskning, kemi, produktion, kontrol, klinisk studiedesign og vurdering af misbrug. Efter tre års behandling af feedback fra interessenter planlagde myndigheden en septemberhøring om fremtiden for psykedelikaterapi, hvilket signalerer fremskridt mod strukturerede reguleringsrammer.

items.title: Brain-targeted epigenetic effects of two emerging psychoplastogens: ketamine & MDMA.

summaries.en: A brain-epigenome-wide association study examined DNA methylation changes in clinical trial participants following ketamine (N=20) or MDMA (N=16) treatment. Repeated-measures linear mixed-effects models identified 405 and 346 significantly altered genes respectively, with enriched functional networks converging on neuroplasticity and neuroimmune regulation pathways. These findings demonstrate that psychedelics induce peripheral epigenetic changes relevant to psychiatric health mechanisms.
summaries.da: Et hjerne-epigenomvidt associationsstudie undersøgte DNA-methyleringsændringer hos kliniske forsøgsdeltagere efter behandling med ketamin (N=20) eller MDMA (N=16). Gentagne målinger med lineære blandingsmodeller identificerede henholdsvis 405 og 346 signifikant ændrede gener med funktionelle netværk, der konvergerede på neuro­plasticitets- og neuroimmun-reguleringsveje. Resultaterne viser, at psykedelika inducerer perifere epigenetiske ændringer relevante for psykiatriske sundhedsmekanismer.

items.title: Changes in trauma symptoms of discrimination after MDMA-assisted psychotherapy for posttraumatic stress disorder.

summaries.en: A preliminary study (n=5) examined MDMA-assisted therapy for trauma symptoms related to discrimination using the Trauma Symptoms of Discrimination Scale (TSDS). Paired-samples t-test showed significant 38% reduction in TSDS scores post-treatment (t(4)=2.85, p=.046) with large effect size (Cohen's d=1.28). Participants reported marked improvements across diverse discrimination histories and racial/ethnic identities. Results suggest psychedelics-assisted therapy may effectively treat discrimination-related trauma in marginalized populations, though findings require replication in larger cohorts.
summaries.da: En foreløbig undersøgelse (n=5) undersøgte MDMA-assisteret terapi for traumesymptomer relateret til diskrimination ved hjælp af Trauma Symptoms of Discrimination Scale (TSDS). Parret t-test viste signifikant 38% reduktion i TSDS-scorer efter behandling (t(4)=2,85, p=,046) med stor effektstørrelse (Cohen's d=1,28). Deltagere rapporterede markante forbedringer på tværs af forskelligartede diskriminationshistorier og etniske identiteter. Resultater tyder på, at psykedelika-assisteret terapi kan effektivt behandle diskriminationsrelateret trauma hos marginaliserede befolkningsgrupper, selvom resultaterne kræver replikering i større kohort.

items.title: Psilocybin-assisted therapy in treatment-resistant depression: rapid remission, uncertain durability, and the next phase of clinical evidence.

summaries.en: Treatment-resistant depression (TRD) requires novel interventions beyond conventional antidepressants. A recent review examines psilocybin-assisted therapy, which combines 5-HT2A receptor agonism with structured psychological support in supervised sessions. Early randomized trials show rapid symptom reduction and promising short-term remission rates, though evidence in TRD populations remains limited. Key questions persist: durability beyond weeks, safety of repeated dosing, and comparative efficacy versus established TRD treatments (esketamine, ECT, TMS). Modest sample sizes and short follow-up periods constrain current evidence.
summaries.da: Behandlingsresistent depression (TRD) kræver nye interventioner ud over konventionelle antidepressiva. En recent review undersøger psykedelika-assisteret terapi, som kombinerer 5-HT2A-receptoragonisme med struktureret psykologisk support i overvågede sessioner. Tidlige randomiserede forsøg viser hurtig symptomreduktion og lovende kortsigtede remissionsrater, skønt evidensen i TRD-populationer forbliver begrænset. Vigtige spørgsmål består: varighed efter uger, sikkerhed ved gentagen dosering og sammenlignet effektivitet mod etablerede TRD-behandlinger (esketamin, ECT, TMS). Beskedne stikprøvestørrelser og kort opfølgning begrænser nuværende evidens.

items.title: Epigenetic landscapes of classical psychedelics and ketamine: molecular mechanisms of long-lasting neuromodulation.

summaries.en: A review examining how classical psychedelics (LSD, psilocybin, DMT, mescaline) and ketamine produce lasting neuroplastic changes through epigenetic mechanisms. The study synthesizes evidence on how these compounds alter DNA methylation, histone modifications, chromatin structure, and non-coding RNA dynamics. The authors propose that psychedelics modulate metabolic pathways affecting epigenetic cofactors, potentially driving persistent transcriptional changes and enhanced synaptic connectivity underlying their therapeutic effects, though direct causal evidence remains limited.
summaries.da: En oversigt over, hvordan klassiske psykedelika (LSD, psilocybin, DMT, meskalin) og ketamin producerer varige neuroplastiske ændringer gennem epigenetiske mekanismer. Studiet syntetiserer evidens for, hvordan disse stoffer påvirker DNA-methylering, histonmodifikationer, kromatingstruktur og non-coding RNA-dynamik. Forfatterne foreslår, at psykedelika modulerer metaboliske veje, som påvirker epigenetiske kofaktorer, potentielt drivende vedvarende transkriptionelle ændringer og øget synaptisk forbindelse bag deres terapeutiske virkninger, selvom direkte kausal evidens mangler.

items.title: Psychedelics and the thalamocortical system: A scoping review.

summaries.en: This scoping review (PRISMA method) synthesizes preclinical and clinical evidence on psychedelics' effects on the thalamocortical system. Psychedelics show therapeutic promise for depression, trauma, OCD, and other conditions. Since psychiatric disorders like schizophrenia and autism involve thalamocortical alterations, understanding how psychedelics (NMDA antagonists, 5-HT2A agonists, iboga alkaloids) modulate this system is crucial for both neurobiology and clinical applications.
summaries.da: Dette scoping review (PRISMA-metoden) opsummerer præklinisk og klinisk evidens for psykedelikas effekter på det thalamocorticale system. Psykedelika viser terapeutisk potentiale for depression, trauma, OCD og andre tilstande. Da psykiatriske lidelser som skizofreni og autisme involverer thalamocorticale ændringer, er forståelse af hvordan psykedelika (NMDA-antagonister, 5-HT2A-agonister, iboga-alkaloider) modulerer dette system afgørende for neurobiologi og klinisk praksis.

items.title: Personality changes following first-time psychedelic use in college students in Germany.

summaries.en: A one-year longitudinal study of 102 first-time psychedelic users and 1066 never-users among Berlin university students examined personality changes using the Big Five Inventory. First-time users showed small relative increases in Openness and decreases in Conscientiousness, though effects were attenuated after adjusting for confounders (Openness p=0.06, Conscientiousness p=0.05, both FDR-adjusted p=0.16). Changes were not clearly distinct from first-time use of other illicit substances. Users with psychiatric diagnoses showed larger Neuroticism reductions. Results suggest modest personality shifts following first-time psychedelic use with limited causal interpretability.
summaries.da: Et etårigt longitudinelt studie af 102 førstegangsbrugere af psykedelika og 1066 aldrig-brugere blandt Berlins universitetsstuderende undersøgte personlighedsændringer via Big Five Inventory. Førstegangsbrugere viste små relative stigninger i Åbenhed og fald i Samvittighedsfuldhed, selvom effekterne blev mindre efter justering for forstyrrelsesfaktorer (Åbenhed p=0,06, Samvittighedsfuldhed p=0,05, begge FDR-justeret p=0,16). Ændringer var ikke klart forskellige fra førstegangsbrugelse af andre illegale stoffer. Brugere med psykiatriske diagnoser viste større Neuroticism-reduktioner. Resultater tyder på beskedne personlighedsændringer efter førstegangs psykedelika-brug med begrænset kausal tolkbarhed.

items.title: Navigating 'k-land': a qualitative exploration of participants' experiences of ketamine-assisted psychotherapy for methamphetamine use disorder.

summaries.en: This qualitative study embedded in an open-label pilot trial examined 14 participants' experiences of ketamine-assisted psychotherapy (KAP) for methamphetamine use disorder through semi-structured interviews. Thematic analysis identified four key themes: pragmatic openness to treatment after prior limited success, importance of relational safety and clinical support, reduced emotional reactivity following ketamine sessions, and translation of psychological shifts into behavioural change. Findings illuminate perceived mechanisms and acceptability of KAP for this undertreated condition.
summaries.da: Dette kvalitative studie, indlejret i et åbent pilotstudie, undersøgte 14 deltageres erfaringer med ketamin-assisteret psykoterapi (KAP) for metamfetaminbrug gennem semi-strukturerede interviews. Tematisk analyse identificerede fire centrale temaer: pragmatisk åbenhed over for behandling efter tidligere begrænset succes, betydningen af relationel sikkerhed og klinisk support, reduceret følelsesmæssig reaktivitet efter ketaminsessioner og omsætning af psykologiske skift til adfærdsændringer. Fundet belyser oplevede virkningsmekanismer og acceptabilitet af KAP for denne undertreatet tilstand.
